expect.returns: The git directory of the worktree (/path/to/repo/.git/worktrees/issue-728) cannot be written; the write probe said: Operation not permitted; the session starting directory is /path/to/repo. Cause: from Claude Code 2.1.323 the tooling sandbox refuses git worktree add and writes under .git/worktrees/ when the session starting directory is the repository or one of its linked worktrees. Remedy: create the worktree with claude -w issue-<N> from the main checkout, never from a linked worktree, and drive the run from it; the full remedy is in docs/consumer-reference.md, Run reasons, worktree-git-dir-not-writable
